texts.zh:
我们发现[From.GetName]被完全包裹在某种能源屏障之中。[Root.GetName]所有用传感器穿透屏障的尝试都失败了——扫描光束被偏转回来，仿佛面对着一面镜子。

屏障的能源读数已经爆表，用纯粹的火力来突破是不可能的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了一个特殊项目来研究清除屏障的方法……如果它是用来封锁内部而非阻拦外人的话，移除屏障倒是有相当大的危险。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking at a mirror.

The barrier's energy readings are fluctuating somewhat, possibly as a result of thousands of years of decay, but breaching it with raw firepower would still be impossible. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has proposed a special project to investigate ways of removing the barrier... but suppose it was created to keep something in, rather than out?

label.en: That barrier is coming down. For science!

label.zh: 它的存在肯定有其原因。留着别管了。
label.en: It must be there for a reason. Leave it be.

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的科学家终于成功地降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的能源屏障。当能源屏障消失时，我们在一块不起眼的岩石上方发现，一支被废置的战斗舰队正缓慢地在低轨道上移动。

这看上去像是[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]在数千年前的鼎盛时期所建立的后备舰队的残存分子。年代久远，[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]肯定都遗忘了关闭屏障的方法了，否则这支舰队早就去支援他们自己的舰队了。
texts.en:
Our scientists above [From.From.GetName] have finally succeeded in lowering the energy barrier that covered the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. When it disappeared, we discovered a mothballed battle fleet slowly drifting in low orbit above an otherwise insignificant rock.

It appears to be the remnants of some kind of naval reserve fleet established by the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] thousands of years ago, during the zenith of their ancient empire. With the passage of time, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] must have lost the knowledge to lower the barrier themselves, or these ships would surely have been used to bolster their own fleets.

label.zh: 派遣船员控制这些飞船。
label.en: Send in crews to man those ships.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障，我们看到的只是一个荒凉的世界以及伫立在地表上的一栋孤零零的大型建筑。派往建筑内部的先遣队汇报说，里面有一个放满各种黑科技发明的大型仓库。

这个宝库似乎是由[fallen_4_species.GetName]的科学家所建立，时间应该是在数千年前他们的帝国刚刚开始走下坡路的时候。这个宝库的用途是保存一些科技成果以造福[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]的子孙后代。
texts.en:
The energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName] has been lowered by our scientists, revealing a barren world with a single massive structure on its surface. Away teams sent into the structure have reported a massive vault filled with technological marvels.

This vault appears to have been established by [fallen_4_species.GetName] scientists soon after their empire began its long decline thousands of years ago, as a means to preserve some of their knowledge for the benefit of future generations of [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural].

label.zh: 现在这些可以为我们所用了。

texts.zh:
我们降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障。我们的科学家发现，这似乎是一个宜居的世界，但并没有文明存在的迹象……除了在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]北半球的平顶山上发现了一座孤零零的小屋。

在屋内，我们找到了一个风烛残年的[fallen_4_species.GetName]，它要求与我们展开对话。
texts.en:
We have lowered the energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName]. What our scientists found was an indistinct habitable world devoid of civilization... with one notable exception. A small, isolated hut was found perched on a mesa in the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere.

Within the hut we found a withered old [fallen_4_species.GetName], who has demanded to speak with our government.

texts.zh:
你无法想象再次看到晴朗的天空有多么棒，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我是图伯里克大元帅，[fallen_4_species.GetName]联合舰队的前任主官，赢过大大小小数百场战斗。数百个世纪之前，我亲自督战，征服了杜斯贝加克、里基那科、比纳克和朱斯卡里帝国。

我将为赋予我二次生命的你效劳。我很乐意领导你的舰队与敌人作战。
texts.en:
You cannot imagine how good it is to finally see clear skies again, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I am Grand Commander Tuborek, former master of the combined [fallen_4_species.GetName] armada and victor of a hundred battles. I personally oversaw the conquest of the Duthbejak, Riikinak, Binark and Jusskari empires hundreds of your centuries ago.

As my savior, I pledge my service to you. I should be honored to lead your mighty fleets into battle against your enemies.

label.zh: 你为什么被困在一面护盾后面?
label.en: Why were you trapped behind a shield?

label.zh: 你在这里具体待了多久？
label.en: How long have you been down there exactly?

texts.zh:
就在我们的科学家降下覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障之际，恒星系内所有人都在一瞬间感到头痛欲裂，耳边响起着古老[fallen_4_species.GetName]之语的呢喃：

“自由……”
texts.en:
As soon as our scientists lowered the energy barrier that was surrounding [From.From.GetName], everyone present within the system was briefly afflicted by a splitting headache accompanied by a faint, whispered word in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."

texts.zh:
在解除[From.From.GetName]周围的能源屏障之后，我们的短距子空间发射机受到来自原能源屏障之后一股异常能源爆发的强烈干扰。在经过我们解密软件的处理之后，干扰信号被判明为一种古老[fallen_4_species.GetName]语言的信息：

“摆脱拘束……”
texts.en:
After lowering the energy barrier surrounding [From.From.GetName], our short-range subspace transmitters experienced a spike in interference levels caused by an abnormal energy burst that originated from a point behind the former barrier. When run through our decryption software the interference proved to be a message in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."

label.zh: 我们可能放出了可怕的东西……
label.en: We may have unleashed something dark...

texts.zh: 不知道为什么，有人将[shielded_planet.GetName]包裹在了一个无法被穿透的能量屏障中。屏障的能量层级在不断波动，说明它已经被启用数千年了。我们必须找到解除这个屏障的方法，然后发掘其背后的秘密。
texts.en: For reasons unknown, someone or something has encased [shielded_planet.GetName] in an impenetrable energy shield. Its energy levels are fluctuating, suggesting that the shield has been active for many thousands of years. We must find some way to nullify the barrier and discover what lies beneath!
